grammar/scanner.c.patch_source: tree-sitter-language-pack 1.20.0, patches/python/serialize-buffer-overflow.patch (MIT); applied with exact context and zero fuzz, as git apply -p1 does

note: crates.io tree-sitter-python 0.25.0 (generated by tree-sitter 0.25.9, ABI 15), the grammar of Graphify 0.9.77's pinned Python parser (tools/comparison-requirements.txt: tree-sitter-python==0.25.0). Every file is the crate's except grammar/scanner.c, which carries the patch: its serializer wrote two bytes per indent level under `size < TREE_SITTER_SERIALIZATION_BUFFER_SIZE`, one byte past the 1,024-byte buffer on a deep indent stack with an odd number of open string delimiters.
